verdict.rationale: Windmill's own AI generation docs show an AI that edits workspace items on request and then opens the Compare & Deploy page with those changes preselected. That is a first-party, prompt-driven editing capability. However, the evidence never states that workflows (flows) specifically can be generated from scratch from a natural-language prompt; it refers only to generic 'items'. AI Agent steps inside flows are a separate feature and do not count here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of generating flows from a prompt, explicit confirmation that flows are among the AI-editable items, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can generate or edit a workflow from a natural-language prompt

citations.quote: Once the AI has edited items, ask it to review the changes and it opens the Compare & Deploy page with exactly those items preselected, ready to deploy.
